items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: This is who that Paul Bob Red Show looks tough there.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you, from what I can understand, he made plenty of money. But it kept on a secret, but he made plenty of money. When he first went there, when he first went with that record, then people were involved in the record. He sold plenty. I didn't do too much, you see, because people was used to that band, you know. And then they had other bands that come up, then the big bands began to come up, you see. And the people got a lack of, and all they heard about Ray's band and all that. Just like you used…
This is who that Paul Bob Red Show looks tough there.
Big gut, he's all wrinkly. I got to go see that. He still lived down on those, um, New Orleans streets yet?
